class.name: GeometryCanvas2DBase
class.brief_description: Shared interactive 2D viewport base class for Tier 1 geometry and spline controls.
class.description: Provides pan, zoom, grid rendering, anchor/handle hit-testing, Y-axis orientation ([member y_down]), and deferred drag preview commits ([member update_commit_policy]). In [constant IdeamToolContext.UPDATE_ON_COMMIT] mode, dragged anchors preview visually at 60+ FPS and commit a single atomic undo/redo action upon pointer release.

method.name: set_view_bounds
method.description: Sets the visible world-space bounding box of the 2D canvas.

method.name: get_view_min
method.description: Returns the minimum visible world-space corner.

method.name: get_view_max
method.description: Returns the maximum visible world-space corner.

method.name: get_show_grid
method.description: Returns whether the background coordinate grid is visible.

members.member: When [code]true[/code], +Y points downward to match Godot's native 2D canvas coordinate system. When [code]false[/code], +Y points upward (mathematical Cartesian convention).
Determines whether point/handle drags commit immediately ([constant IdeamToolContext.UPDATE_IMMEDIATE]) or preview visually and commit once on release ([constant IdeamToolContext.UPDATE_ON_COMMIT]).

signal.name: point_selected
signal.description: Emitted when the user selects a control point.

signal.name: section_selected
signal.description: Emitted when the user selects a curve/edge section.

signal.name: commit_completed
signal.description: Emitted after an interactive edit commits an undo/redo action.

constants.constant: Allows dragging anchors freely along both X and Y.
Constrains anchor dragging to the horizontal X axis.
Constrains anchor dragging to the vertical Y axis.
